cards.imageAlt: Complicated airport，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Have you had any complicated airport training in simulator?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机里面接受过复杂机场的训练吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I received some complicated airport training in simulator.
It largely improves my flight skills and techniques.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我在模拟机里接受过相关复杂机场的训练。
它极大的提升了我的飞行技术和技巧。

cards.audioText: How to make a successful landing at a complicated airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何在复杂机场成功着陆？
cards.referenceText:
We should pay attention to the surrounding environments including complicated weather conditions.
make a stable approach, and make sure speed and heading are correctly set.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们应关注机场周围环境，包括复杂的天气条件。
做稳定进近，并确保速度和航向设置正确。

cards.audioText: What can you learn from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这张图上你可以看到什么？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see a complicated airport with short and narrow runway. The airport is located near the seaside, it is very easy for pilots to encounter wind shear when landing on this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图上，我看到一个有窄短跑道的复杂机场，机场位于海边，在这种机场降落时，飞行员很容易遭遇风切变。
